verdict.rationale: Dropbox documents a Files API for creating, reading, editing, moving, and deleting files and folders. Supporting evidence includes official API reference pages, a guide on performant file uploads, and official SDKs, including a JS SDK example calling filesListFolder. Together these show programmatic file operations beyond the desktop client. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of specific REST HTTP endpoints for upload and download (the HTTP docs markdown probe returned 404 and no OpenAPI spec was found), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the endpoints.
